projects.title: Danse Macabre
projects.decision: Native project_id danse and the legacy canonical URL identify private GitHub repository 1320324017. The distinct public personal repository 1347780050 is archived and explicitly defers to that canonical URL. Authority is resolved; all four previously unpushed commits are remotely recoverable through existing feature and private preservation refs. Independent source custody and portable acceptance remain incomplete. Preserve both remotes and the existing checkout.

projects.title: hole-loop

capabilities.description: Resolve explicit composition configuration independently from software identity.
Create dialogue-processing candidates and expressive audio returns.
Apply source-timed effects to authored spatial regions and layers.
Associate learned person-mask candidates with authored spatial regions.
Render source-addressed camera, typography, retiming and attention-score edits.
Assemble bounded source-unit schedules with explicit listened-review admission.
Verify hash-bound inputs and dispatch retained native recipe formats.
Evaluate typed audiovisual effect graphs and controls.
Build, refine and stretch room-audio material from source intervals.
Export editable timing and media-comparison handoffs.
Validate independent loop identities, clocks, events, and paired authored layouts.
Compile and stage bounded browser previews without resetting loops on orientation changes.
Render loop compositions and explicitly authored audio through FFmpeg.
Generate synthetic engineering media and composition fixtures.
Verify and adapt pinned external playback generations without copying or replacing the shared engine.
Configurable encounter transitions, session memory and monotonic eligible-exposure timing without artwork content or DOM dependencies.
Manage Three.js scene, camera, renderer, postprocessing and adaptive quality lifecycle.
Analyze frequency bands and beat events for audiovisual reactivity.
Play and spatially mix configured audio stems with existing legacy defaults and fallback paths.
Advance image-grid frames using configured order and loop rules.
